composition.serve_who: This sheet is the vessel's Electrical System GA (108-01-600-001, SW 108). It comprises two views: (1) an interior plan (deck plan with cabin/compartment layout and frame stations) whose only electrical content is a set of location callouts for battery banks (GMDSS, Emergency, Engine Start) near the engine room/tech room, and a technical-spaces plan view showing the physical arrangement of BAE hybrid-drive equipment (ISG-P/S, MPCS-P/S, BEL1/2-P/S, MAPS-P/S, EDN-P/S, ESS1-3) in the engine room; and (2) a full one-line electrical schematic covering shore power intake, the 24V DC bus structure (Service/vessel LVPDU, Backup Generator Start, Emergency, GMDSS boards), the BAE Systems hybrid propulsion/energy system (ISG, MPCS, HVPDU, MAPS, BEL inverters, EDN chargers, ESS), the 230V AC bus and Main AC Panel, and the various pump/consumer groups (liquid cooling circulation pumps, steering helm stations) fed from these buses. Evidence: title block reads 'ELECTRICAL SYSTEM GA'; the legend defines AC/DC line colors, contactors, switches, solenoids; boxed sections are explicitly labelled (24V SERVICE BOARD, 24V BACKUP GENERATOR START BOARD, 24V EMERGENCY BOARD, 24V GMDSS BOARD, MAIN AC PANEL, BAE SYSTEMS SUPPLY, LIQUID COOLING CIRCULATION PUMPS, STEERING HELM STATIONS).

equipment_groups.equipment_name: BAE Hybrid System (hub) / Integrated Starter Generators (ISG Port & Stbd)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The two 'BAE SYSTEMS SUPPLY' boxes each show an engine driving an alternator/'INTEGRATED STARTER GENERATOR' feeding an MPCS, matching the ISG nodes; the overall hybrid drive/energy hub is the BAE system node.

functions.label: Engine-driven starter/generator supplies propulsion power system
functions.what_it_does: Each main engine (port and stbd, labelled 'INTEGRATED STARTER GENERATOR PROPULSION SYSTEM ISG') drives an alternator that feeds its Modular Propulsion Control System (MPCS), which in turn connects to the 600V DC bus for hybrid propulsion.

flow_scenarios.path: Engine (port or stbd) → ISG/alternator → MPCS-P/-S → 600V DC bus (magenta line) → HVPDU / drive-train consumers

key_components: Hydraulic motor — port/stbd steering pump (ancillary, driven off same shaft per diagram note)

No explicit sheet label found for SCU3 (System Control Unit) or Emergency Inverter as distinct boxes; the 24V control/monitor bus implies their presence but no direct callout was legible — not composed to avoid inventing a connection.

Aux Service Battery Bank (634) has no distinct box on this sheet; the 24V Service Board appears alternator/BAE-fed rather than from a separate labelled aux battery — flagged as no equipment evidence found on this sheet.
Individual part numbers/model callouts on charger and pump icons are not legible; function and role are recorded per rule 11, part numbers to be captured at inspection if ever needed.

Interior plan battery location callouts (GMDSS/Emergency/Engine Start Batteries) are given only as frame-adjacent labels (~frame G-H); exact frame/compartment boundary not fully certain from image resolution.
